bio.text: Gina Hinojosa, a Democrat, represents central Austin in the Texas House of Representatives and won the Democratic nomination for governor in the March 2026 primary.

According to her House biography, she was born and raised in the Rio Grande Valley, is a University of Texas alumna, graduated from law school at George Washington in Washington, D.C., and began her career as a civil rights and labor lawyer.
She was first elected to the Austin ISD school board and served as its president before running for the Texas House in 2016.
